content:
Pagination অনেকের কাছে সহজ মনে হয়, কিন্তু boundary value পরিস্থিতিগুলো মিস হলে Production-এ blank page, duplicate data বা server crash দেখা দেয়।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-PAGE-001: First page with default page size
Method: GET /api/products?page=1&pageSize=10
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Returns first 10 records
  - Response includes: { "data": [...], "page": 1, "pageSize": 10, "total": 150, "totalPages": 15 }

TC-PAGE-002: Second page
Query: page=2&pageSize=10
Expected: Records 11-20, no overlap with page 1

TC-PAGE-003: Last page
Query: page=15&pageSize=10 (if total=150)
Expected: Returns last 10 records (records 141-150)

TC-PAGE-004: Last page with partial data
If total=145, last page (page=15) should have 5 records
Expected: Returns exactly 5 records, NOT empty
---

Boundary Value Tests

TC-PAGE-005: Page beyond last page
Query: page=999&pageSize=10 (when only 15 pages exist)
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Response: { "data": [], "page": 999, "total": 150 }
  - NOT 404 or 500

TC-PAGE-006: Page number = 0
Query: page=0&pageSize=10
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "Page number must be greater than 0."

TC-PAGE-007: Negative page number
Query: page=-1&pageSize=10
Expected: 400 Bad Request

TC-PAGE-008: pageSize = 0
Expected: 400, "Page size must be at least 1."

TC-PAGE-009: Very large pageSize (e.g., 10000)
Expected: Either 400 (if max enforced) or capped at max allowed (e.g., 100)

TC-PAGE-010: pageSize = 1 (minimum)
Expected: Returns exactly 1 record per page
---

Data Integrity Tests

TC-PAGE-011: No duplicate records across pages
Steps: Fetch all pages, combine results, check for duplicate IDs
Expected: Zero duplicates

TC-PAGE-012: Total count consistency
Expected: sum of all page item counts == "total" in metadata

TC-PAGE-013: Pagination with sort applied
Query: page=2&pageSize=5&sort=price_asc
Expected: Records 6-10 sorted by price ascending — order maintained across pages
---

পরিশেষে

Pagination-এর সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ টেস্ট হলো "last page with partial data" এবং "page beyond total" — এই দুটো বাস্তব ব্যবহারে প্রায়ই সমস্যা তৈরি করে। Total count consistency চেক করলে Backend-এর counting logic-এর ভুলও ধরা পড়ে।

Tags: #PaginationTesting #APITesting #BoundaryValue #DataIntegrity #QA #SQA
